scenes.caption: Morning sun.
scenes.say: Fatima's family has solar panels on the roof of their home.

scenes.caption: Renewable.
scenes.say: Sunlight is renewable energy. It will not run out.

scenes.caption: Saving water.
scenes.say: She turns off the tap while she brushes her teeth.

scenes.caption: Three Rs.
scenes.say: At school, they reduce, reuse and then recycle.

scenes.caption: Food miles.
scenes.say: She chooses local fruit with fewer food miles.

scenes.caption: Trade by sea.
scenes.say: Cargo ships carry goods between countries.

scenes.caption: Fair trade.
scenes.say: Fair trade helps farmers get a fair price.

scenes.caption: Sustainable.
scenes.say: Small choices by many people help our one planet.
